item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: SQL Server 2025 support on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
item.description:
SQL Server 2025 is now in public preview on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. This lets users evaluate, test, and deploy SQL Server on Canonical’s latest long-term supported platform.

  • Source: Azure Updates
